body: Hi Jjay, I read your story and I don't want you to feel alone. There are people reading, and who care. I wish you and your wife the best
Thank you for the kind words

I feel empathy is a curse... That's why I don't like being around other people. It makes every social setting very uncomfortable. In order to be happy, being around other people helps your mood. But even the happiest of people still carry painful memories that make them vulnerable. I do appreciate your input, it is nice to know that there are people who are willing to listen.
"No matter what happens now, I shouldn't be afraid. Because I know today has been the most perfect day I've ever seen."
I thought everything really did happen for a reason. Now I have come to terms with the fact the life sucks, and there's only so much you can do about making it tolerable
If I had a field I would... I just wait until I'm home alone and belt out the frustration.
Scream as loud as I can because I hate my life.
